number: 第二百四十八条の三の三
heading_en: CVA Risk Equivalent Amount under the Full BA-CVA
summary_ja: 完全なBA―CVAによるCVAリスク相当額は、K_{full}（K_{reduced}とK_{hedged}の加重和）に割引係数0.65を乗じて算出する。SCVA_{C}、SNH_{C}、IH、HMA_{C}の算式とリスク・ウェイト表を定める。
summary_en: The full BA-CVA amount is K_{full} (a weighted combination of K_{reduced} and K_{hedged}) times a discount scalar of 0.65; the article gives the formulas for SCVA_{C}, SNH_{C}, IH and HMA_{C} and the risk-weight tables.
paragraphs: The CVA risk equivalent amount under the full BA-CVA that an Ultimate Designated Parent Company calculates reflecting the hedging effect of the eligible BA-CVA hedge transactions shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the required capital amount (K_{full}) calculated by the following formula by the discount scalar (DS_{BA-CVA}) of 0.65. K_{full} = β·K_{reduced} + (1 − β)·K_{hedged} {{F:p277i0}} {{F:p277i1}} β is 0.25. SCVA_{C} is the CVA capital charge for all netting sets with counterparty c. ρ is 0.5. SNH_{C} is the value of the hedging effect of all single-name hedges on the CVA risk of counterparty c. IH is the value of the hedging effect on the CVA risk of all counterparties arising from hedge transactions using indices. HMA_{C} is the value of all hedge transactions on the CVA risk of counterparty c.

In this case, the phrase "where it is less than one year, one year, and where it exceeds five years, five years" in the proviso to paragraph (1) of that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "where it is less than one year, one year"; provided, however, that where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company has received the approval under Article 49, paragraph (1), M_{NS} shall be the effective maturity calculated under Article 135, paragraph (1). RW_{i} in the preceding paragraph is the risk weight applied to index hedges, and shall be the risk weight set out in the table in paragraph (3) according to the sector category of the counterparty and the category of the counterparty's creditworthiness corresponding to the rating assigned to the counterparty by an eligible rating agency. In this case, the following adjustments shall be made according to the category of case listed in the following items. (i) Where all constituents of the index belong to the same sector and have the same creditworthiness: the risk weight shall be the value obtained by multiplying the risk weight set out in the table in paragraph (3) by 0.7. (ii) Where not all constituents of the index belong to the same sector, or where the index includes both investment grade and speculative grade and unrated constituents: the risk weight shall be the value obtained by taking the weighted average of the risk weights set out in the table in paragraph (3) according to the number of constituents, and multiplying it by 0.7.
